assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Activity-based protein profiling (ABPP) of serine hydrolases

acquisition: The Orbitrap was operated in “Data Dependent Acquisition” mode
MS was operated in Data Dependent Acquisition mode
labeling: Peptide samples were dissolved in 25 μL of 50 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate buffer (TEAB, Sigma). 0.2 mg of TMT label reagents (Thermo Fisher Scientific TMTsixplexTM product number 90308, lot numberRH239931 or TMTtenplexTM product number 90309, lot numberRH239932) were dissolved in 65 μL anhydrous ACN.
quantification: Quantification was done at MS2 level using TMT-six/tenplex labels.
enrichment: we used fluorophosphonate broad-spectrum activity-based probes and quantitative chemical proteomics to annotate and profile the activity of more than half of predicted serine hydrolases
Biotin labelled proteins were then enriched over neutravidin-agarose.
Labeled proteins were affinity purified using a 10:20 μL mixture of neutravidin:blank agarose beads.

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses Activity-Based Protein Profiling (ABPP) specifically targeting serine hydrolases using fluorophosphonate (FP) probes. While this is a PTM-like enrichment (covalent modification), it does not map to the specific PTM modifiers provided in the ontology list (e.g., phospho, acetyl, ubiquitin). Therefore, no specific modifier_candidate from the provided list was selected, but proteomics_mode is set to PTM-enriched due to the covalent probe capture.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The primary proteomics experiment is a stage-dependent activity profile using an activity-based probe (FP-N3) compared to a DMSO control across the P. falciparum life cycle. While the paper also describes conditional genetic mutants (cMUT) and chemical inhibition assays for parasite growth, these are phenotypic validation experiments and not the primary MS-analyzed differential proteomics setup.
